specs.intent: Build the parse layer of the 'judgment injector' praxis plugin in this repo (/Users/johnzdanis/jdev/skills/corpora). Read injector-design.md and domain-file.md in the repo root first — they are the spec. Create a Python package `judgment_injector/` with: (1) `models.py` defining three frozen-ish dataclasses — `Convention(id:str, rule:str)`; `Principle(id:str, rule:str, condition:str, reason:str)`; and `Domain` with fields exactly: `id:str, owner:(str|None), subject:str, posture:str, applies_when:list[dict], universal:bool, task_kinds:list[str], workflows:list[str], labels:list[str], conventions:list[Convention], principles:list[Principle], source_path:(Path|None)=None`, plus mutable runtime fields `weight:float=1.0` and `registration_index:int=0` (set later by selection, default here). `Domain.fq` property returns f'{owner}/{id}'. (2) `parser.py` with `parse_domain_file(path, owner=None) -> Domain` that parses a domain-file.md: split the leading YAML frontmatter block delimited by --- lines, parse it with pyyaml; the remaining body contains two YAML sequences under `conventions:` and `principles:` headings (per domain-file.md 'File anatomy' — the body IS yaml with those top-level keys), parse the whole body as YAML and read its `conventions`/`principles` lists. subject and posture and id are required (raise ValueError if missing). Defaults per the domain-file.md frontmatter spec: applies-when absent -> [], universal absent -> False, task-kinds/workflows/labels absent -> []. Map the YAML key `applies-when` to field `applies_when` and `task-kinds` to `task_kinds`. If the file declares `owner` in frontmatter it must agree with a passed-in owner (if both present and differ, raise); the derived/passed owner is authoritative. Set source_path. (3) `facet_weights.yaml` — copy the exact table from injector-design.md's 'facet-weights.yaml' block (task_kind create/change/explore, stance convergent/divergent/none, workflow tdd/build-verify, label '*'). (4) `weights.py` with `load_weights(path=None)` returning an object/namespace giving attribute access like W.task_kind['create'].convention_weight, W.stance['divergent'].anchor / .convention_multiplier / .suppress_posture (use .get semantics; suppress_posture may be absent -> None), W.workflow['tdd']['weight'], W.label['*']['pin_weight']; default path = the packaged facet_weights.yaml. Also add `__init__.py`. Follow the design's field semantics precisely. Do NOT ship any domain files — the injector composes over others' domains and has none of its own.

specs.intent: Build the compose layer of the judgment-injector plugin, on top of the parse layer already created in `judgment_injector/` (models.py provides Domain/Convention/Principle; parser.py provides parse_domain_file; weights.py provides load_weights). Read injector-design.md and domain-file.md first. Create: (1) `discovery.py` with `discover_domain_dirs(root) -> list[tuple[str, Path]]` implementing the design's pseudocode: import `contributors` from praxis (add /Users/johnzdanis/.claude/skills/praxis to sys.path if needed; use `from contributors import contributors_for`), iterate contributors_for(root), for each read optional attribute `domains_dir`, and if set append (c.source, Path(domains_dir)); ALWAYS append ('project', root/'.praxis'/'domains') last (present even if the dir is absent). The injector itself has NO domains_dir. And `merge_pool(dirs) -> list[Domain]` that globs each dir for *.md, parses each via parse_domain_file(path, owner=<source>), stamps owner from the source, and merges per domain-file.md precedence: fully-qualified `owner/id` appearing twice within one owner is a hard error (skip+report, do not silently last-wins); across the two layers plugin<project, same bare `id` -> project version REPLACES the plugin version wholesale (drop the plugin one); peer plugins (same layer) with same bare id COEXIST as distinct owner/id; different bare ids coexist. Preserve registration order into `registration_index` for later tie-breaking (project after plugins, or by contributors_for order). Return the flat list of survivors. (2) `injector.py` with `class JudgmentInjector` (source='judgment-injector', NO domains_dir attribute) taking (root, weights) in __init__; a `contribute(self, s) -> list[Contribution]` implementing the design's contribute() pseudocode exactly: DISCOVER+MERGE via merge_pool(discover_domain_dirs(root)); subject filter (keep universal or subject==s.subject); shape prune via `shape_ok(applies_when, project_shape)`; modulate weights by task_kind affinity(*1.5), workflow, label pins; sort by (-weight, registration_index); then emit Contributions — anti-mean anchor at priority -10 only when s.phase=='divergent'; conventions preamble at priority 0 (suppressed when task_kind convention_weight<=0 i.e. explore, or stance convention_multiplier<=0 i.e. divergent, and skip a domain whose posture==stance.suppress_posture); domain principles per surviving domain at priority 10 titled f'{owner}/{id} — principles'; workflow process principles at priority 20 only for domains whose workflows contains s.workflow. Import Contribution via `from contributors import Contribution`. Include helpers `shape_ok(applies_when, shape)` implementing the applies-when mini-syntax (equals, `not-none`, and one-of list; AND across all; empty shape value/unset fails not-none and equals but a domain with empty applies_when always passes), `render_principles(principles, lens)` emitting each principle's rule/condition/reason as prose (lens only orders/frames, NEVER filters on condition), `terse_list(lines)`, and `ANTI_MEAN_ANCHOR_TEXT`. IMPORTANT: the real praxis `Situation` (see /Users/johnzdanis/.claude/skills/praxis/situation.py) has NO `project_shape` field — source project_shape inside contribute() from praxis config: `import config; shape = config.read(root, 'project_shape') or {}` defaulting to {} (all domains pass shape prune when empty). Read s.task_kind, s.subject, s.phase, s.workflow, s.label off the Situation. (3) Add `make(root)` factory in injector.py returning JudgmentInjector(root, load_weights()) so it registers as a praxis contributor via `judgment_injector.injector:make`.

specs.intent: Write a pytest suite under `tests/` for the judgment-injector plugin in this repo. Add /Users/johnzdanis/.claude/skills/praxis and the repo root to sys.path so `import config`, `from contributors import Contribution, contributors_for`, and `import judgment_injector...` all resolve. Cover: (1) parser — parses a sample domain-file.md (use the coding-general example from domain-file.md) into a Domain with correct conventions/principles, defaults applied, owner agreement error when frontmatter owner disagrees, required-field errors. (2) discovery/merge precedence — build temp dirs: project domain with same bare id as a plugin domain overrides wholesale (plugin dropped); two peer plugins with same bare id coexist as distinct owner/id; same owner/id twice is a hard error (skipped/reported); different ids coexist; discover_domain_dirs always includes the ('project', root/.praxis/domains) entry even when absent. (3) injector.contribute — reproduce the three worked examples from injector-design.md: (a) coding/change/convergent/workflow=build-verify emits priority-0 conventions + priority-10 principles + priority-20 process, no -10 anchor; (b) design/create/divergent/label=color emits the -10 anti-mean anchor, suppresses convergent-posture conventions, and boosts the color domain to lead; (c) coding/explore/none suppresses conventions entirely (priority-0 absent) but still emits principles. (4) empty-by-default — no domain-carrying contributors registered and empty local pool -> contribute() returns []. Build Situations via `from situation import Situation`. Register fake domain-carrying contributors by writing them to a temp module + praxis config `contributors` namespace (mirror tests/test_contributors.py pattern in the praxis repo) OR by dropping domain files into root/.praxis/domains. Set project_shape via `config.write(root,'project_shape',{...})` where a worked example needs shape pruning. Make the suite runnable with `python3 -m pytest tests/ -q` from the repo root and ensure it passes.
specs.subject: coding

specs.intent: Write a concise README.md for the judgment-injector praxis plugin in this repo root. Cover: what it is (a pure-composer praxis contributor that injects reusable engineering/design judgment from domain files before a task runs, shipping NO domains of its own); how to register it in a consuming praxis root (add to `.praxis/config.json` contributors namespace as `"judgment-injector": "judgment_injector.injector:make"`, ensuring the package is importable on sys.path); how a plugin becomes judgment-bearing (ship a domains/ dir and expose its path as a `domains_dir` attribute on the contributor); the project-local pool at root/.praxis/domains (owner=project, overrides plugins wholesale on same bare id); the two-layer body model (conventions vs principles) and the empty-by-default guarantee; and note the project_shape config key the injector reads for shape pruning. Point readers to injector-design.md and domain-file.md for the full spec. Keep it tight — a page. Do not restate the whole design.
specs.subject: prose
